The current fraud model v2 deployment has no human review path for refused SIM replacement requests, exposing a gap in the operator's change and fairness controls.

UAE consumer protection provisions require customer care availability but do not explicitly require a human review/escalation path or time-bound remediation when automated fraud controls refuse legitimate SIM-replacement requests.
